body.x: EcoFlow, a leader in portable power and eco-friendly energy solutions, unveiled its groundbreaking AI-powered energy management system, EcoFlow OASIS, at CES 2025 in Las Vegas. Designed to enhance home energy storage, prepare for weather-related power outages, and reduce electricity costs, OASIS marks a new era of smart energy solutions for homeowners.

Since its founding in 2017, EcoFlow has empowered over 4.5 million users in 140 markets worldwide. It is committed to being the "FIRST" in power solutions: Flexible, Innovative, Reliable, Simple, and Thorough.

EcoFlow OASIS leverages artificial intelligence and real-time data, such as past energy consumption, local electricity rates, solar energy generation, and weather patterns, to provide personalized recommendations. With the ability to automate energy-saving actions, OASIS ensures batteries are charged before severe weather and optimizes energy usage to reduce costs. The built-in smart assistant responds to natural language queries, offering actionable insights like maximizing solar energy use or shifting energy-intensive tasks to cost-efficient periods. “As the first in the portable power industry to launch a user-focused mobile app, EcoFlow now leads again by integrating AI into a comprehensive energy management system,” said Peter Linghu, EcoFlow's Director of Product Strategy and Development.

body.cap: | EcoFlow showcased OASIS energy management solution at CES 2025 | Photo by EcoFlow.

body.x: EcoFlow OASIS integrates seamlessly with EcoFlow products like DELTA 3 Plus and RIVER 3 Plus, offering features such as Storm Warning Alerts and Time-of-Use Mode. Its full capabilities are realized in EcoFlow's Whole-Home Power Backup Solutions, including DELTA Pro Ultra with Smart Home Panel 2 in North America and PowerOcean grid-tied energy systems in Europe. EcoFlow also plans to launch OCEAN Pro, a grid-tied solar battery solution, in the U.S. later this year, fully leveraging OASIS’s advanced AI functionalities. Additionally, OASIS supports third-party devices compatible with Shelly and Matter, providing a unified overview of energy sources, consumption insights, and management controls—an industry-first innovation. Linghu emphasized, “With increasingly capable systems, EcoFlow OASIS simplifies home energy management, maximizing the value of every energy investment.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
